correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact hypergeometric indicator decomposition yields P=n*C(n²-n,k-1)/C(n²,k) and J=[C((n-1)²,k-1)+(n-1)² C((n-1)²,k-2)]/C(n²,k), then Cov=n²(J-P²). Factorial cancellation gives the stated product for J/P². Uniform expansion at k=cn with c bounded positive yields log(J/P²)=-(c-2)²/(2n²)+a(c)/n³+O(n^-4) where a(2)=2/3. Thus Cov→-c²(c-2)² exp(-2c)/2; in k=2n+x sqrt n+o(sqrt n), nCov→e^-4(8/3-2x²), with boundary signs deliberately unspecified. Independently computed exact binomial moments for n=10,30,100,200 at k=2n; nCov≈0.0561333,0.0513003,0.0495763,0.0492085 approaching 8 e^-4/3≈0.048841.
